# S1176: attrib

<a id="s1176"></a>

Type: tool  
ATT&CK: [S1176](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1176)  
Platforms: Windows  
Aliases: attrib.exe  

[attrib](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1176) is a Windows utility used to display, set or remove attributes assigned to files or directories.
